purpose: Classify save identity, role, byte identity, and save/game version compatibility before any exact-save load or runtime mutation.

modes.catalog: Classify all supplied/discovered saves without granting load authority. Incompatible saves remain blocked per-record and do not poison unrelated targets.
modes.gate: Evaluate one explicit target save plus approved-alias pair integrity for launcher-lifecycle consumption.

inputs: one or more .sav paths or read-only discovery under the Bannerlord Game Saves roots
exact installed game executable version, preferably from the current game-compatibility result
rules: Save bytes are read only; classification never changes write timestamps, contents, names, or directories.
A filename containing disposable or dev language grants role classification only; it never overrides version compatibility.
Autosaves are never selected as approved aliases merely because they are newer on disk.
Catalog mode is inventory, not load authorization; blocked records may coexist with a compatible target.
Gate mode requires an explicit target and returns that target's first applicable terminal state.
Exact save/game version match plus an automation-eligible role is required for automatic reuse by the exact-save launcher path.
A save newer than the installed game fails closed before launcher action.
An older save is attention-only and requires an explicit runtime recertification lane before automatic reuse.
Unknown or ambiguous parsed versions fail closed.
The approved alias pair must be byte-identical and report the same parsed version when either alias is present.
Creating a new save belongs to launcher/runtime authority; after creation this classifier must record the new file's observed bytes and version before reuse.
Prelaunch compatibility does not prove that the game accepted or loaded the save. The in-game load boundary requires separate same-run evidence.

consumers.gate: Only gate-mode PASS_SAVE_VERSION_EXACT with an automation-eligible role and satisfied approved-alias integrity may advance into exact-save selection; the launcher must still prove the in-game load boundary.
Save classification may be cited as prelaunch provenance only and cannot promote launcher or runtime proof.
Map traversal and priority-engine work begins only after the launcher/runtime lanes independently prove campaign readiness.

forbiddenScope: click or dismiss launcher or in-game dialogs
claim campaign readiness or live runtime
